title: 晶粒拾取與精密放置
summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入薄晶粒取放、座標轉換與受力保護。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore thin-die handling, coordinate transforms and load protection, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

steps.title: 後段可接合性｜證據與診斷
steps.objective: 針對後段可接合性，把「精準位置、無裂紋與潔淨表面需共同驗證。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For downstream bondability, turn "Position accuracy, crack absence and cleanliness need joint validation." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：交付逐顆座標、缺陷與來源追溯。 將「放置良率等於最終接合良率」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Deliver per-die coordinates, defects and source traceability. Challenge the hypothesis "Equating placement yield with final bonding yield" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 交付逐顆座標、缺陷與來源追溯。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Deliver per-die coordinates, defects and source traceability. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：放置良率等於最終接合良率。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Equating placement yield with final bonding yield. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付後段可接合性的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for downstream bondability: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.
